sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 小新台湾 (Crayon Shin-chan TW) CBT 测试首周报告
模块编号 : 06 - 付费路径与首购/复购承接分析 (TW CBT vs SG CBT/OBT)
数据表   : 
  - 小新繁体 CBT: ta.v_event_18 (AppID 18)
  - 小新新加坡  : ta.v_event_13 (AppID 13)
核心逻辑 :
  1. 按用户付费时间序列判定 首次付费商品 (First Purchase SKU)
  2. 统计首购商品带来的后续二次复购率 (%) 及复购贡献总流水 ($)
  3. 识别 TOP 1st SKU ➔ 2nd SKU 转化承接路径
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),

-- 1. 提取充值序列
UserPaySeq AS (
    SELECT
        '1.小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), '0'),
            'unknown_sku'
        ) AS raw_sku,
        COALESCE(CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(s5.exchange, 1), 0.0) AS amount,
        e."#event_time" AS pay_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."#user_id" ORDER BY e."#event_time" ASC) AS pay_order
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange s5
      ON e."$part_date" = s5.ex_date
     AND e.pay_currency = s5.currency
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '2.小新新加坡OBT1' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), '0'),
            'unknown_sku'
        ) AS raw_sku,
        COALESCE(CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE), 0.0) AS amount,
        e."#event_time" AS pay_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."#user_id" ORDER BY e."#event_time" ASC) AS pay_order
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),

NormalizedPaySeq AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        pay_order,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN raw_sku) > 0 THEN ELEMENT_AT(SPLIT(raw_sku, '.'), -1)
            ELSE raw_sku
        END AS sku_id,
        amount,
        pay_time
    FROM UserPaySeq
),

FirstPurchases AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        sku_id AS first_sku,
        amount AS first_amount,
        pay_time AS first_pay_time
    FROM NormalizedPaySeq
    WHERE pay_order = 1
),

SecondPurchases AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        sku_id AS second_sku,
        amount AS second_amount,
        pay_time AS second_pay_time
    FROM NormalizedPaySeq
    WHERE pay_order = 2
),

RepeatSummary AS (
    SELECT
        f.cohort_name,
        f.user_id,
        f.first_sku,
        f.first_amount,
        CASE WHEN s.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_repeat_payer,
        s.second_sku,
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM NormalizedPaySeq n WHERE n.cohort_name = f.cohort_name AND n.user_id = f.user_id AND n.pay_order > 1), 0.0) AS repeat_total_amount
    FROM FirstPurchases f
    LEFT JOIN SecondPurchases s ON f.cohort_name = s.cohort_name AND f.user_id = s.user_id
)

SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    first_sku AS "首购商品ID",
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "首购人数",
    SUM(is_repeat_payer) AS "产生复购人数",
    ROUND(SUM(is_repeat_payer) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 2) AS "复购转化率(%)",
    ROUND(SUM(first_amount), 2) AS "首购贡献流水($)",
    ROUND(SUM(repeat_total_amount), 2) AS "后续复购贡献流水($)",
    ROUND(SUM(first_amount + repeat_total_amount), 2) AS "全周期贡献总流水($)"
FROM RepeatSummary
GROUP BY cohort_name, first_sku
ORDER BY "对比组", "全周期贡献总流水($)" DESC
